Standard Dice

Games built on standard six-sided dice. Standard six-sided dice support five games spanning press-your-luck, betting, bluffing, and category-scoring families. Roll, set aside combinations, and decide whether to bank or risk it all.

5 Variants
standard-dice Plugin
✓ Frontmatter-only

Declared, Not Coded

Every rule of Standard Dice below is frontmatter in the rules corpus. The board beside each is the game itself, live.

Bunco Rules

Social dice game for 12 players in 3 tables of 4 (2 teams of 2 per table). 6 rounds, each targeting a number 1–6. Roll 3 dice; score 1 point per die showing the target number. Roll all three matching the target = Bunco (21 points, round ends). Fast, social, no strategy.

engine:
  topology:
    type: tableau
    layout: radial
  players: [player1, player2, player3, player4, player5, player6, player7, player8, player9, pl…
  plugins:
    standard-dice:
      game: rolling-rounds
      dice: 3
      rounds: 6
      bunco: 21
      threeOfAKind: 5
      roundEnds: 21

Craps Rules

The definitive casino dice game. Two dice. Come-out roll: 7 or 11 wins (Pass), 2/3/12 loses (craps), any other number becomes the Point. Point phase: match the Point before rolling 7 to win; roll 7 first (seven-out) to lose. Pass and Don't Pass are the core bets; the Odds bet behind them carries no house edge.

engine:
  topology:
    type: tableau
    layout: radial
  players: [player1, player2]
  plugins:
    standard-dice:
      game: shooting
      chips:
        start: 100
        bets: [1, 2, 5, 10, 25]
      shooters: 2
      options:
        shooters:
          label: Turns to shoot
          values: [1, 2, 3]
